# OG Studio integration

This is an adapted copy of the user's OG Studio project, pinned from local project
revision `5504233d757360cdec0ca718c663bcb7a1c1e420`. The standalone project is unchanged.

The integration adds an origin-checked parent-message bridge for per-note designs,
private persistence, cover export, and reliable closing. Embedded toolbar widths and
status wording are adjusted for the Notes workspace. Existing editing, import/export,
download, palette, image, font, and positioning controls remain available.

DM Sans is distributed with its original SIL Open Font License in `fonts/OFL.txt`.
